objects.description: Primary JSON value type of the library (templated alias known as nlohmann::json). Stores any JSON value (null, object, array, string, boolean, number, binary). Manages dynamic memory for objects/arrays/strings/binary via an internal union and allocator helpers. Provides full STL-like container interface, parsing/serialization, binary formats, JSON Pointer, Patch, and Merge Patch. Construction via many constructors, static helpers (array, object, binary), and parse functions. Destruction handled by internal data::~data which calls json_value::destroy according to current value type.

template <typename ValueType, typename T>
template <typename BasicJsonType, typename TargetType = ValueType>
static auto nlohmann::adl_serializer<ValueType, T>::from_json(BasicJsonType&& j, TargetType& val) noexcept(noexcept(::nlohmann::from_json(std::forward<BasicJsonType>(j), val))) -> decltype(::nlohmann::from_json(std::forward<BasicJsonType>(j), val), void())
functions.description: Converts a JSON value into an existing TargetType object by delegating to ::nlohmann::from_json via ADL. This is the ADL customization hook used by nlohmann::json: users specialize adl_serializer<ValueType, T> for their types to enable deserialization. Use when you already have an instance to populate.
requirements: There must exist a viable overload of ::nlohmann::from_json(BasicJsonType&&, TargetType&) found via ADL for the provided BasicJsonType and TargetType.
BasicJsonType must be a JSON type compatible with nlohmann::json (typically a nlohmann::basic_json specialization) or something accepted by the selected ::nlohmann::from_json.
val must be a valid reference to a TargetType object ready to receive deserialized data.
Any constraints or preconditions required by the selected ::nlohmann::from_json must be satisfied (e.g., JSON structure matches TargetType).
Exceptions: The function is noexcept if and only if the delegated ::nlohmann::from_json call is noexcept; otherwise it may throw whatever ::nlohmann::from_json throws.

requirements: There must exist a viable overload of ::nlohmann::from_json(BasicJsonType&&, ::nlohmann::detail::identity_tag<TargetType>) found via ADL for the provided BasicJsonType and TargetType.

template <typename ValueType, typename T>
template <typename BasicJsonType, typename TargetType = ValueType>
static auto nlohmann::adl_serializer<ValueType, T>::to_json(BasicJsonType& j, TargetType&& val) noexcept(noexcept(::nlohmann::to_json(j, std::forward<TargetType>(val)))) -> decltype(::nlohmann::to_json(j, std::forward<TargetType>(val)), void())
functions.description: Converts a value of TargetType into a JSON value by delegating to ::nlohmann::to_json via ADL, storing the result into j. This is the ADL customization hook used by nlohmann::json: users specialize adl_serializer<ValueType, T> for their types to enable serialization. Use when you need to populate an existing JSON object/array/value from a C++ value.
requirements: There must exist a viable overload of ::nlohmann::to_json(BasicJsonType&, TargetType&&) found via ADL for the provided BasicJsonType and TargetType.

j must be a valid JSON container compatible with nlohmann::json (typically a nlohmann::basic_json specialization) or something accepted by the selected ::nlohmann::to_json; it will be assigned/modified by the operation.
val must be a value convertible by the selected ::nlohmann::to_json; it may be moved from if TargetType is an rvalue.
Exceptions: The function is noexcept if and only if the delegated ::nlohmann::to_json call is noexcept; otherwise it may throw whatever ::nlohmann::to_json throws.

functions.name: nlohmann::byte_container_with_subtype::byte_container_with_subtype
functions.description: Default-constructs a byte_container_with_subtype, default-constructing the underlying BinaryType. Subtype is cleared (no subtype). Use when you want an empty container without a subtype set.
requirements: BinaryType must be default-constructible.
The constructor is noexcept if and only if BinaryType() is noexcept.

functions.name: nlohmann::byte_container_with_subtype::operator==
functions.description: Compares two byte_container_with_subtype objects for equality. Equality requires the underlying BinaryType contents, the stored subtype value, and the presence flag (has_subtype) to all match.
requirements: BinaryType must be equality-comparable (operator==) because comparison delegates to the underlying container via std::tie.

functions.name: nlohmann::byte_container_with_subtype::operator!=
functions.description: Inequality comparison; logical negation of operator==.
requirements: BinaryType must be equality-comparable (operator==) since this relies on operator==.

functions.name: nlohmann::byte_container_with_subtype::set_subtype
functions.description: Sets the binary subtype to subtype_ and marks the value as having a subtype. Use to assign or update the subtype metadata associated with the contained bytes.
requirements: subtype_ must be provided as a 64-bit unsigned integer. No further range constraints are enforced.

functions.name: nlohmann::byte_container_with_subtype::subtype
functions.signature:
template <typename BinaryType>
constexpr std::uint64_t nlohmann::byte_container_with_subtype<BinaryType>::subtype() const noexcept
functions.description: Returns the stored subtype if one is set; otherwise returns the sentinel value static_cast<std::uint64_t>(-1) (i.e., 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF). Typically, callers should check has_subtype() before using the returned value.
requirements: Callers should check has_subtype() to distinguish an unset subtype from a real value, since the function returns a sentinel when no subtype is set.

functions.name: nlohmann::byte_container_with_subtype::has_subtype
functions.signature:
template <typename BinaryType>
constexpr bool nlohmann::byte_container_with_subtype<BinaryType>::has_subtype() const noexcept
functions.description: Indicates whether a subtype value is currently associated with the container.

functions.name: nlohmann::byte_container_with_subtype::clear_subtype
functions.description: Clears the subtype association. After calling, has_subtype() returns false, and subtype() will return the sentinel value (max uint64). The stored internal subtype field is reset to 0 but is ignored while has_subtype() is false.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::ordered_map
functions.description: Default constructor. Creates an empty ordered_map with default-constructed underlying vector and comparator. Preserves insertion order.
requirements: Allocator must be nothrow-movable/constructible as required by std::vector for noexcept to hold (inferred from noexcept specification).
No additional runtime requirements.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::ordered_map
functions.description: Allocator-accepting constructor. Creates an empty ordered_map using the provided allocator.
requirements: alloc must be a valid allocator for value_type = std::pair<const Key, T>.
Allocator must meet std::vector's allocator requirements; noexcept depends on Container(alloc).

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::ordered_map
functions.signature:
template <class It>
ordered_map(It first, It last, const Allocator& alloc = Allocator())
functions.description: Range constructor. Constructs the container with the contents of the range [first, last), preserving order.
requirements: first and last must form a valid range; they must be iterators into a sequence of value_type (std::pair<const Key, T>) or convertible to it (as required by std::vector's range constructor).
Both iterators must be at least input iterators.
If the elements are not exactly value_type, they must be convertible to value_type.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::ordered_map
functions.description: Initializer-list constructor. Constructs the container from the initializer list, preserving the given order.
requirements: init elements must be value_type (std::pair<const Key, T>).

If duplicate keys are present in init, later duplicates are not implicitly coalesced here; duplicates remain and uniqueness is only enforced by insert/emplace usage (note: this constructor forwards to underlying vector without duplicate checks).

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::emplace
functions.signature: std::pair<iterator, bool> emplace(const key_type& key, T&& t)
functions.description: Insert-or-find by key. If key is not present, appends a new element {key, std::forward<T>(t)} at the end and returns {iterator_to_new, true}. If key exists, returns {iterator_to_existing, false}. Preserves insertion order; no reordering occurs.
requirements: Key equality is determined by key_compare (default std::equal_to<Key> or transparent equal_to<>).
Linear search is performed; complexity is O(n).
No duplicate insertion: if a matching key exists, no insertion occurs.
T must be move-constructible into mapped value_type.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::emplace
functions.signature:
template<class KeyType, detail::enable_if_t<detail::is_usable_as_key_type<key_compare, key_type, KeyType>::value, int> = 0>
std::pair<iterator, bool> emplace(KeyType&& key, T&& t)
functions.description: Transparent insert-or-find overload. Accepts heterogeneous key types when key_compare supports it. Inserts {key, t} if not found; otherwise returns existing element.
requirements: KeyType must be usable as a key according to detail::is_usable_as_key_type with key_compare and key_type (i.e., comparable by key_compare and constructible to key_type).
KeyType must allow constructing the stored key_type (Key) inside pair<const Key, T>.
T must be move-constructible.
No insertion occurs if a matching key is already present; returns iterator to existing and false.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::operator[]
functions.description: Access-or-insert element by key. Returns a reference to the mapped value for key. If key does not exist, inserts a new element with default-constructed T and returns a reference to it.
requirements: If key is missing, T must be default-constructible (T{} is used).
Key equality is determined by key_compare.
Linear search; may reallocate underlying vector on insertion.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::operator[]
functions.signature:
template<class KeyType, detail::enable_if_t<detail::is_usable_as_key_type<key_compare, key_type, KeyType>::value, int> = 0>
T& operator[](KeyType&& key)
functions.description: Transparent access-or-insert. Like operator[](const key_type&), but accepts heterogeneous key types when supported by key_compare. Inserts default-constructed T if key is missing.
requirements: KeyType must be usable as a key according to detail::is_usable_as_key_type with key_compare and key_type.
KeyType must be constructible to key_type (Key) for storage.
T must be default-constructible if insertion is needed.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::operator[]
functions.signature: const T& operator[](const key_type& key) const
functions.description: Const access by key. Returns a const reference to the mapped value. If the key is not found, throws std::out_of_range via at().
requirements: Key must exist; otherwise std::out_of_range is thrown.
Key equality is determined by key_compare.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::operator[]
functions.signature:
template<class KeyType, detail::enable_if_t<detail::is_usable_as_key_type<key_compare, key_type, KeyType>::value, int> = 0>
const T& operator[](KeyType&& key) const
functions.description: Const transparent access by key. Returns a const reference to the mapped value using heterogeneous lookup if supported. Throws std::out_of_range if key is not found.
requirements: KeyType must be usable as a key according to detail::is_usable_as_key_type with key_compare and key_type.
Key must exist; otherwise std::out_of_range is thrown.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::at
functions.description: Bounds-checked access. Returns a reference to the mapped value for key, or throws std::out_of_range if key does not exist.
requirements: Throws std::out_of_range("key not found") if key is absent.
Key equality is determined by key_compare.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::at
functions.signature:
template<class KeyType, detail::enable_if_t<detail::is_usable_as_key_type<key_compare, key_type, KeyType>::value, int> = 0>
T& at(KeyType&& key)
functions.description: Transparent bounds-checked access. Like at(const key_type&), but accepts heterogeneous key types when supported. Throws std::out_of_range if key does not exist.
requirements: KeyType must be usable as a key according to detail::is_usable_as_key_type with key_compare and key_type.
Throws std::out_of_range("key not found") if key is absent.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::at
functions.signature: const T& at(const key_type& key) const
functions.description: Const bounds-checked access. Returns a const reference to the mapped value for key or throws std::out_of_range if not present.
requirements: Throws std::out_of_range("key not found") if key is absent.
Key equality is determined by key_compare.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::at
functions.signature:
template<class KeyType, detail::enable_if_t<detail::is_usable_as_key_type<key_compare, key_type, KeyType>::value, int> = 0>
const T& at(KeyType&& key) const
functions.description: Const transparent bounds-checked access. Returns a const reference to the value for a heterogeneous key; throws std::out_of_range if the key is missing.
requirements: KeyType must be usable as a key according to detail::is_usable_as_key_type with key_compare and key_type.
Throws std::out_of_range("key not found") if key is absent.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::erase
functions.description: Erases the element with the given key if present. Returns 1 if an element was erased, 0 otherwise. Maintains order by moving subsequent elements forward and popping the back.
requirements: Key equality is determined by key_compare.
If an element is erased, value_type must be move-constructible (used to shift elements).

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::erase
functions.signature:
template<class KeyType, detail::enable_if_t<detail::is_usable_as_key_type<key_compare, key_type, KeyType>::value, int> = 0>
size_type erase(KeyType&& key)
functions.description: Transparent key erase. Removes the element matching the heterogeneous key if present. Returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise.
requirements: KeyType must be usable as a key according to detail::is_usable_as_key_type with key_compare and key_type.
If an element is erased, value_type must be move-constructible.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::erase
functions.description: Erases the element at pos and returns an iterator to the element that follows the erased one (or end() if none).
requirements: pos must be a valid iterator referring to an element in this container (must not be end()); passing end() is invalid due to use of std::next(pos).
Iterator pos must originate from this container; undefined behavior otherwise.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::erase
functions.description: Erases the range [first, last) and returns an iterator to the element that follows the last erased element (i.e., the element now at position first), or end() if none. Maintains order by shifting following elements forward and resizing.
requirements: first and last must be valid iterators from this container forming a valid range (first <= last).
Iterators must not be invalidated by external operations during erase.
Range may be empty; in that case, returns first.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::count
functions.description: Returns 1 if an element with the given key exists, 0 otherwise. Linear search using key_compare.
requirements: None beyond valid key comparison using key_compare.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::count
functions.signature:
template<class KeyType, detail::enable_if_t<detail::is_usable_as_key_type<key_compare, key_type, KeyType>::value, int> = 0>
size_type count(KeyType&& key) const
functions.description: Transparent count. Returns 1 if an element matching the heterogeneous key exists, 0 otherwise.
requirements: KeyType must be usable as a key according to detail::is_usable_as_key_type with key_compare and key_type.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::find
functions.description: Finds an element with the given key and returns an iterator to it, or end() if not found. Linear search using key_compare.
requirements: None beyond valid key comparison using key_compare.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::find
functions.signature:
template<class KeyType, detail::enable_if_t<detail::is_usable_as_key_type<key_compare, key_type, KeyType>::value, int> = 0>
iterator find(KeyType&& key)
functions.description: Transparent find. Searches using a heterogeneous key when supported and returns an iterator to the element or end() if not found.
requirements: KeyType must be usable as a key according to detail::is_usable_as_key_type with key_compare and key_type.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::find
functions.description: Const find. Returns a const_iterator to the element with the given key, or end() if not found.
requirements: None beyond valid key comparison using key_compare.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::insert
functions.description: Inserts the given key/value pair if the key is not present. Returns {iterator_to_element, true} on insertion, or {iterator_to_existing, false} if the key already exists. Preserves insertion order by appending on insert.
requirements: If an element with the same key exists (per key_compare), no insertion occurs.
value.first must be constructible to stored key_type (Key) if needed by pair conversion.
Mapped value T must be move-constructible.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::insert
functions.description: Inserts a copy of value if its key is not present; otherwise returns iterator to existing element with false. Appends on insertion to preserve order.
requirements: value must be a valid value_type (std::pair<const Key, T>).
If an element with the same key exists (per key_compare), no insertion occurs.

functions.name: nlohmann::ordered_map::insert
functions.signature:
template<typename InputIt, typename = require_input_iter<InputIt>>
void insert(InputIt first, InputIt last)
functions.description: Range insert. Inserts all elements from the range [first, last), individually applying the key-unique insertion rule (duplicates are skipped). Preserves order of first occurrences relative to input iteration.
requirements: InputIt must satisfy input iterator requirements (std::input_iterator_tag convertible).
*first must be dereferenceable to a value convertible to value_type (std::pair<const Key, T>).
Each element insertion follows single-element insert rules: duplicates by key are not inserted.
